risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially defective or with hidden flaws.

risks.risk: Battery or internal components may be degraded or non-functional
risks.proof: Video showing the camera powering on, recording a short clip, and playing it back on the screen.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (e.g., charger, case, cables) not shown in photos
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories, which reduces value.

Close-up photos of the lens and screen for scratches or damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an Insta360 X3 digital camera from visible branding. The condition claim is unverified but not contradicted by the photos. Hidden risks exist but are common for used electronics; the item can be priced at its worst case (e.g., not working or missing accessories) until proof is provided.
